notes: This scenario validates flow Fortra_OrderItem_Set_Workday_Contract_Line_Type, NOT a V21 pricing-procedure step. Active version is V11 (not V8/V9/V10). V11 abandons Original_Order_Item__c reverse-lookup entirely; Decision_Is_Subsplit gates purely on Product2.Is_Subsplit_Product__c (true -> BILLING ONLY; false -> does NOT stamp BILLING ONLY, routes to FIXED AMOUNT for Perpetual). Quantity-split order 00095498: 3 lines of 5250 Integrator (Is_Subsplit_Product__c=false), parent + 2 children by Original_Order_Item__c, all correctly stamped FIXED AMOUNT. Subsplit control 00095631: all Is_Subsplit_Product__c=true lines correctly stamped FIXED AMOUNT BILLING ONLY; Is_Subsplit_Product__c=false lines correctly NOT stamped BILLING ONLY. Stale legacy stamp on 802WC00000OQLFwYAP (order 00095351, Order Complete status) is a V10-era relic and does not reflect V11 behavior. The scenario's described defect (V9/V10 always-true detection) was fixed in V11 and remains fixed today.
verdict_reason: Quantity-split parent/children (same product, Is_Subsplit_Product__c=false) correctly stamped FIXED AMOUNT on live post-V11 order 00095498. Subsplit products (Is_Subsplit_Product__c=true) correctly stamped FIXED AMOUNT BILLING ONLY on order 00095631. Both branches of V11 Decision_Is_Subsplit validated against real existing records. V11 mechanism supersedes V8/V9/V10 and is confirmed Active in FortraUAT. PASS.
